anchors.extracted: People planning to attend a ceremony with a classic psychedelic (psilocybin mushrooms or truffles, ayahuasca, DMT, San Pedro, LSD or 1P-LSD) were recruited by online advertisements to a study website; eligibility: aged 18 or over, good English, and the intention to take part in a retreat, ceremony or other guided experience with a classic psychedelic. anchors.source_read: PDF PDFs/Psilocybin/MacLean_2011_PsilocybinOpenness.pdf (version of record, Journal of Psychopharmacology 25(11), pp. 1453–1461; text layer read in full; pp. 1455–1458 rendered at 150 dpi and Figure 1 at 300 dpi)
anchors.extracted: Participants were told they would receive a moderate or high dose of psilocybin in one session, without knowing which. Study 1: psilocybin 30 mg/70 kg in one session and methylphenidate 40 mg/70 kg in the other one or two; Study 2: 5, 10, 20 and 30 mg/70 kg in ascending or descending order with a placebo session inserted quasi-randomly (study conditions). At least 8 hours of preparation meetings with the monitors; sessions lying on a couch with an eye mask and music. NEO PI-R (240 items, T scores from combined-sex norms) at screening, 1–2 months after each session and about 14 months after the last session. The analysis pools the two studies for power; the high-dose session in Study 2 could not be fully isolated from the lower doses, and personality after it was always measured within 1–2 months and before any later session.

anchors.extracted: Orientation preference repeats about every 300 µm in cat V1 and about every 0.5 mm in macaque V1; cells less than 0.5 mm apart connect roughly isotropically, while long horizontal axons in layers II and III contact patches of similar orientation about every 0.5 mm along the axis of their orientation preference (owl monkey and tree shrew images, partly a personal communication); these come almost entirely from excitatory neurons, 20% ending on inhibitory cells. Some anatomical and psychophysical evidence puts human hypercolumn spacing at about 1.33–2 mm; with a human V1 of about 3,500 mm² per hemisphere and hypercolumns of about 2.67 mm², about 1,300 hypercolumns. The model assumes all orientations at every position and a continuum, although many hallucination patterns have wavelengths of about twice the hypercolumn spacing.
